guide.intro: Index prescript mode reads the game screen while you run the Mirror Dungeon and gives you prescripts. Carry one out and you earn grace (points). There is no done button: whether you obeyed is judged from the screen only.
guide.formationTitle: Opening formation grace (each of the twelve)
guide.example: Example: a strength 3 shop prescript, 5th in a row, Proselyte, 300 starlight spent on blessings → 20 × 1.5 (shop) × 1.2 (streak) × 1.68 (starlight) ≈ 60

sections.title: Setup
items: On a PC in Chrome or Edge, press "Turn the terminal on" → "Connect the terminal" and share the Limbus window.
The screen is read in this browser only. Nothing is sent anywhere.
"Float the terminal" shows it in a small window (PiP) over the game.
A 16:9 game window reads best. Windows covering the game cannot be read through.
"Settings" sets the sound level and previews the arrival sound and CLEAR/FAIL.

sections.title: Flow
items: The dungeon entry screen brings the opening orders (they cannot be refused).
Floor prescripts start once the floor 1 theme pack screen is read. The lobby (floor 0) gives none.
Prescripts come as three cards. Pick one and it becomes yours to carry out.
Keep the terminal on until the dungeon's end screen, or the run is not recorded.

sections.title: Kinds of prescripts
items: Standing: always one. Carry it out and the next comes.
This floor: one a floor, due before the next theme pack is picked.
Shop: one a shop, due before you leave it.
Room: given as you enter a choice room. Pick the named option. Cannot be refused.
Opening orders: given at the dungeon entry, about the formation, the start gift and the observed gift. Cannot be refused.
Penance: given at once after a violation. Heavier, cannot be refused, due on this floor.

sections.title: Receiving prescripts
items: Each card shows its strength (1 to 5) and the grace it gives.
A Proselyte has 20 s to pick, a Proxy 12 s. Pick nothing and the terminal picks for you.
A reroll draws three new cards (Proselyte 3, Proxy 1).
A Proselyte may decline. Each refusal raises the weakest strength offered by one; each prescript carried out lowers it by one.
A card whose moment passed (shop left, floor changed) counts as a violation.

sections.title: Opening orders
items: Formation: field any Identities. Each of the twelve is graced by its rarity (table below), in any order. All 1★ gives the most (120).
The formation grace is set when the formation bar at the bottom of the shop screen is first read whole (all twelve), usually at the first shop.
Start gift: take the named start gift. Taking only other gifts of its keyword is a violation.
Observed gift: take the named gift by observation.
If the pick and the acquisition screens were not read, it is recalled, not judged.

sections.title: Star Blessing factor
items: The less starlight spent on Star Blessings before entering, the more every prescript of the run is worth.
None: ×2. All ten at ++ (930 starlight): ×1. In between it follows the starlight: factor = 1 + (930 − spent) ÷ 930.
Upgrades (+, ++) cost more starlight, so they lower the factor too.
If the blessing screen was not read, the factor is ×1.

sections.title: Scoring
items: Grace = base by strength (table below) × kind × streak × terminal grade × Star Blessing factor.
Kind: standing ×1, every other kind (floor, shop, room, opening, penance) ×1.5.
Streak: ×1.1 from the 3rd in a row, ×1.2 from the 5th, ×1.5 from the 10th.
The 3rd, 5th and 10th in a row add +10, +25 and +60 and give a reroll back.
Terminal grade: Proselyte ×1, Proxy ×1.5.
In an Identity formation prescript, a 2★ stand-in of the same keyword gives +50%, a 1★ one or leaving the base Identity as it is +110%.
The opening formation grace is the table's points × the Star Blessing factor and does not count toward the streak.
A violation breaks the streak, makes the next prescripts heavier and brings a penance. Breaking a penance costs that much grace.
A recall (could not be judged) is neither points nor a violation.

sections.title: What is read to judge
items: Gifts gained: the acquisition popup (purchases, start and observed gifts too).
Sales: the sell window. Fusions: the fusion window and the popup after it.
Floors and packs: the theme pack screen's floor and the pack picked.
Shop shelf: the shop screen. Slots scrolled out of view are remembered for the visit.
Formation: the Identity bar at the bottom of the shop screen.
Choices: the result screen, the result text on the left, the next stage and the mouse cursor. If they disagree, it is recalled.

sections.title: Things to watch
items: If the screen share stops or the terminal is turned off before the dungeon ends, that run's grace and record are lost.
Popups or result screens skipped very fast may be missed. The last 15 s are re-read, but what never showed is recalled.
In choice rooms, let the result screen show at least briefly.
1★ Identities do not count for "swap the Identity", "field keyword Identities in the first six" or "field it in places 1 to 6".
Sharing the whole screen ignores the site's own text, but sharing only the game window is more accurate.
Records stay in this browser only. Clearing its data removes them.
